12:87.text: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people."

12:88.text: So when they entered upon him
, they said, "O ʿAzeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allāh rewards the charitable."

12:89.text: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?"

12:90.text: They said, "Are you indeed Joseph?" He said, "I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allāh has certainly favored us. Indeed, he who fears Allāh and is patient, then indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good."

12:91.text: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners."

12:92.text: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. May Allāh forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.

12:93.text: Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together."

12:94.text: "Indeed, I find the smell of Joseph
[and would say that he was alive]
if you did not think me weakened in mind."
